summary: The 14,952 readable Figure 1c gene labels share no exact or case-insensitive match with the 5,764 genes deposited in GEO or the 5,143 genes in the registered food-cue comparison. The discrepancy is already present in the author sources. Identifying the exported gene set and the four gene names stored as Excel dates requires the original analysis files.

manualReview.summary: Figure 1c and the GEO matrix describe the same food-cue comparison but share no readable gene labels
manualReview.note: GEO and the registered input contain the same gene-by-sample values for six NEO and six SENS libraries. The registered variance filter removes 621 genes with zero CPM in every library. All 14,952 readable Figure 1c labels are already absent from the unfiltered deposit. The original workbook stores four additional gene identifiers as numeric dates. GEO describes a 10-read cutoff but does not identify which side of that cutoff was exported. Effects, direction, raw P and FDR agreement remain unassessed.
reviewFlags: The registered output covers the deposited gene set. Its agreement with the reported POMC translatome cannot be measured on identifiable genes.
The identities of the four date cells and the provenance of the CPM export require author confirmation.

verificationReview.reason: Figure 1c reports SENS relative to NEO. The figure and registered output describe the same arms, but their identifiable gene sets are disjoint even before the registered variance filter. The original workbook contains dates without gene IDs in four cells. Even matching every date cell would yield at most four pairs under the recorded identifier rule, below the 30 required for author-concordance-v2. The CPM export and its metadata cannot establish whether it contains genes excluded by the authors' filter.
verificationReview.nextStep: Which featureCounts matrix and filtering rule produced Figure 1c for the 12 NEO/SENS libraries, and which rows were exported to GSE224274_CPM-Gys.txt.gz? Please provide the original sample-labelled matrix with stable gene IDs, the kept/excluded row lists or export code, and the original IDs for Fig.1c cells A1361, A10699, A10933 and A11775.
